subject: Eastern Clinic: Technical safeguards questionnaire & BAA timeline
messages:
From: Dr. Laura Greene <laura@easternclinic.org>
To: irene.choi@redwoodai.com
Cc: procurement@easternclinic.org
Date: 2026-11-18T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Eastern Clinic – HIPAA questionnaire and BAA timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking our inquiry. Attached is Eastern Clinic's standard HIPAA technical safeguards questionnaire (we've highlighted PHI flows and retention questions). We're running an accelerated procurement window and need: 1) confirmation that Redwood can sign a standard BAA (we can share our template), 2) SOC 2 Type II evidence, 3) high-level dataflow and key management details for both hosted and dedicated modes.

Could you confirm whether you can provide a draft BAA within 3 business days and whether you support HSM-backed KMS for dedicated/private deployments? Also please note our security team will want answers on log retention (90/365 day options) and controls around KV cache persistence.

Deadline for our legal review is 2026-11-26.

Attachments: EasternClinic_HIPAA_Questionnaire.xlsx; EasternClinic_Procurement_Portal_Link.txt

Regards,
Dr. Laura Greene
Lead, Clinical Systems Procurement
Eastern Clinic Health System

From: irene.choi@redwoodai.com
To: Dr. Laura Greene <laura@easternclinic.org>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodai.com, monica.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:43:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Eastern Clinic – HIPAA questionnaire and BAA timeline

Hi Laura —

Thanks for sending this over and for the timeline. We can meet the legal review window; our legal team can produce a redlined BAA draft within 2 business days once we receive your template. Operationally:

- SOC 2 Type II (2026) is available and we can provide the report under NDA.
- For hosted API, PHI is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest; we offer customer-managed key integration for Dedicated/Private via KMS (Cloud KMS + optional HSM in Dedicated).
- KV cache: default ephemeral caches do not persist PHI; for workloads needing warm-start caching we provide configurable TTLs and opt-in persistence with encryption at rest.
- Log retention: configurable per-customer retention up to 365 days; we can scope audit log exports to S3 or an on-prem SIEM feed.

I'm looping in Aditya for the contract/terms discussion and Monica for technical evidence and diagrams. Quick ask: can you clarify whether you need on-prem (air-gapped) packaging for any production environment, or will dedicated VPC deployments be sufficient?

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Irene / Aditya —

Thanks for the quick responses. A couple of clarifications from our side before the call:

1) We will need HSM-backed KMS for keys that protect PHI in Dedicated and for any backup snapshots containing PHI.
2) For on-prem: we don't require full air-gapped at this stage; a VPC-dedicated deployment with customer-managed KMS is acceptable, though we'll want an implementation plan for potential future air-gapped needs.
3) Log retention: we expect immutable audit logs for at least 365 days with export capability to our SIEM.
4) Please confirm whether Redwood's KV cache can be disabled entirely for routes that process PHI.

I've uploaded the questionnaire to the procurement portal and added a procurement note referencing the timeline. Link is in the portal upload confirmation (see attachment).

Looking forward to the proposed call on 11/20.

Best,
Laura

From: monica.patel@redwoodai.com
To: Dr. Laura Greene <laura@easternclinic.org>, irene.choi@redwoodai.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-19T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Eastern Clinic – HIPAA questionnaire and BAA timeline

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the pointers, and great to hear the portal upload is complete. Quick answers inline: 

- HSM-backed KMS: supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. We use FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs in our Dedicated KMS option; key operations are restricted via role-based policies. We'll provide an HSM architecture diagram on the call.
- Backups/snapshots: encrypted with the same KMS keys; we can configure separate backup keys and rotation windows per customer.
- KV cache: yes — per-route KV cache can be disabled. For PHI routes we recommend disable + cold start, or enable ephemeral-only caching (no disk persistence).
- Immutable audit logs: we support append-only audit record streams and can ship daily exports to your SIEM with 365-day retention; for additional immutability we can write hash-chained digests to a WORM S3 bucket under customer-managed retention policy.

I'll attach a redacted dataflow diagram and a draft BAA to this thread for your legal team's first pass. Monica (legal) will be copied on the next redline if you provide your template.

Proposed attachments: redacted_dataflow_diagram.pdf (stub); BAA_draft_v1.docx

See you on 11/20.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
